# Adagio Dazzle

Adagio Dazzle is the calculating, orange-haired leader and lead singer of **the Dazzlings**, alongside Aria Blaze and Sonata Dusk. In *Equestria Girls: Rainbow Rocks* (2014), she looks human but is actually a magical **siren exiled from Equestria**. Her trio weaponizes singing and red gem pendants to feed on conflict and dominate Canterlot High. Hasbro's [official character introduction](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BVYXfJ9PJTc) identifies her as the group's ringleader.

**Recognize her:** Huge orange curls with yellow streaks, pale yellow-green skin, raspberry eyes, a purple spiked headband, purple-and-pink clothes, and a conspicuous red pendant. Her siren form is a finned, aquatic creature; in the film her magic can project that form above the stage.

**Name and voice:** *Adagio Dazzle* is her official name, not a fandom nickname or a disguise. An early 2014 rumor confused it with Vinyl Scratch/DJ Pon-3's name; Meghan McCarthy rejected that identification ([contemporary report](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/01/adagio-dazzle-is-not-dj-p0n-3vinyl.html)). She **speaks and sings** in English as performed by **Kazumi Evans** ([film credits](https://www.moviefone.com/movie/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-rainbow-rocks/20056958/credits/)).

**Where she appears:** Main villain in *Rainbow Rocks*; a siren in a flashback in *Friendship Is Magic* S7E26, “Shadow Play – Part 2”; later a singer in the *Find the Magic* [official music video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cYa0Um8EG-c) and a speaking character in *Sunset's Backstage Pass* (2019). She also appears in licensed IDW comics, including *FIENDship Is Magic* #3. The film/specials and TV flashback are official G4 stories; comics provide additional adaptation material ([character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Adagio_Dazzle)).

## Important moments

- **Banished from Equestria — “Shadow Play – Part 2” (S7E26):** The sirens spread discord until Somnambula and the Pillars stop them, establishing Adagio's backstory. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U01UcYIdjU8); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **A school-wide musical feud — *Rainbow Rocks* (film, no S/E):** Adagio turns a friendly showcase into a competitive Battle of the Bands to harvest the students' anger. [Official full film](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=onN0ITgCjs0); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **“Under Our Spell” — *Rainbow Rocks* (film):** Her hypnotic performance tightens the Dazzlings' control of the school. [Official performance video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6aLA9soAQVU); film timestamp unavailable.
- **Her power is broken — *Rainbow Rocks* (film):** Sunset and the Rainbooms overcome the sirens, shattering their enchanted pendants and ending their spell (same full film above; timestamp unavailable).
- **An unexpected lesson for Sunset — *Sunset's Backstage Pass* (2019 special; no S/E):** No longer magical, Adagio says every day already offers a chance to change, helping Sunset rethink a time loop. [Official special](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7lLQxB9vFV8); scene timestamp unavailable.
